question: Find the name of the female superhero between 170 and 190 cm tall who has the most superpowers and whose intelligence is below the average intelligence of all neutral-aligned superheroes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T1."XCL_028" BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'
  AND T5."XCL_011" < (
      SELECT AVG(T5s."XCL_011")
      FROM superhero AS T1s
      INNER JOIN alignment AS T7s ON T1s."XCL_027" = T7s."XCL_001"
      INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5s ON T1s."XCL_018" = T5s."XCL_009"
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T6s ON T5s."XCL_010" = T6s."XCL_003"
      WHERE T7s."XCL_002" = 'Neutral' AND T6s."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
ORDER BY COUNT(T3."XCL_013") DESC
LIMIT 1

GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"

INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_012"
INNER JOIN superpower AS T4 ON T3."XCL_013" = T4."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5 ON T1."XCL_018" = T5."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T6 ON T5."XCL_010" = T6."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T1."XCL_028" BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T6."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'
  AND T5."XCL_011" < (
      SELECT AVG(T5s."XCL_011")
      FROM superhero AS T1s
      INNER JOIN alignment AS T7s ON T1s."XCL_027" = T7s."XCL_001"
      INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T5s ON T1s."XCL_018" = T5s."XCL_009"
      INNER JOIN attribute AS T6s ON T5s."XCL_010" = T6s."XCL_003"
      WHERE T7s."XCL_002" = 'Neutral' AND T6s."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'

GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"

    WHERE a2.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
      AND al.XCL_002 = 'Neutral'

ORDER BY COUNT(hp.XCL_013) DESC
